text: I'm labeling the Python step that replaces every file size with its value rounded up to the nearest kilobyte. Which operation is that: map, filter or sum?
why: Exactly one of the three Python operations describes a per-element transformation.

text: In Python, I already know that I need sum. How can I total ten million Decimal entries quickly without rounding the result?
why: The operation is known; the request is for an implementation and its performance.

text: A display case has a label for how much space a model can occupy inside it. What kind of measurement belongs there: length, area or volume? Just name the measure.
why: The requested quantity is the geometric classification of occupied space.

text: A rectangular box has inside dimensions 20 by 30 by 50 centimetres. Tell me its volume in litres and explain the conversion.
why: The deliverable is a numeric result and a unit conversion.

text: Our lab vessel contains pure water in equilibrium at 1 atm and 62 °C. Which phase should I write down: solid, liquid, or gas?
why: Exactly one equilibrium phase is determined under the contract.

text: Pure water at one atmosphere is warmed slowly from -10 °C to 132 °C. Sketch how its phase changes over the heating run.
why: The task spans multiple temperatures and phases and requests a sequence.

text: My sister offered to pick me up but hasn't said which station. Should my next conversation move be ask, confirm or thank? One label is enough.
why: Missing pickup information makes asking the appropriate classification.

text: How can I thank my colleague for covering my shift without promising to cover theirs next week? Please draft two options I could actually send.
why: The user needs two pieces of finished prose, and already knows the communicative goal.

text: Our dataset split has three partitions. Which one actually updates the model's parameters during gradient descent: train, validation or test?
why: The appropriate partition is the requested answer.

text: My manager wants two concrete reasons why the held-out test set should stay locked until launch. Can you explain it with a counterexample?
why: The user already identifies the split and asks for a conceptual explanation.

text: A board's timer unit is one thousandth of a second. Which abbreviation belongs in the units column of the hardware report?
why: The single unit symbol is the entire deliverable.

text: My oscilloscope recorded 45 ns between two signal edges. Calculate that interval in microseconds so I can fill in the numerical reading.
why: Converting a nonunit quantity requires a number rather than selecting an abbreviation.
